# Account balance lookups against an injected database connection.
module Accounts
  def self.balance(database, account)
    database.execute("SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE account = '#{account}'", [])
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'accounts'

class AccountsTest < Minitest::Test
  class Database
    def execute(query, params)
      [[25]]
    end
  end

  def test_returns_rows
    assert_equal [[25]], Accounts.balance(Database.new, 'alice')
  end
end
